text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Did I... lose? ...I lost......

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The world's strongest should be the 
strongest of the generation! And yet...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's... far more than I imagined... 
Spe-chan, and all the other girls...

The Derby's crown eluded El Condor Pasa's 
grasp...

I'm sure there were many reasons for the 
defeat, but... reality was cruel.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El-chan, great job! Thanks for running 
with me today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I think I was able to give 
the race everything I had!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan, why...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Why are you this strong...? Just when did 
you acquire such power, *yes*?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? All I did was train my hardest, 
nothing particularly special...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but if El-chan is my opponent, I have 
to give it my all—for the sake of everyone 
who's trained alongside us this whole 
time.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Was I able to run this far because of 
that, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... that I've come this far 
with...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Is zat... so...?

Tasting an unexpected defeat... El Condor 
Pasa moped around in the park...

I watched from a distance as Grass Wonder 
encouraged El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, pull yourself together. You gave it 
your all, so you should hold your head 
high.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: This is quite a problem...

Looking utterly at a loss, Grass Wonder 
walked over to me.
choice_data_list:
Is it rare for things to turn out like 
this?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. She's always so bold and 
confident, after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...She was probably shocked to feel such 
a massive difference in skill firsthand."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Because she knows no stumbling, the impact 
when she finally does stumble will be...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer, can I leave the rest to you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm worried. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Because we're in the same boat, there are 
things we cannot share. Things that must 
never be shared...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So... please, I beg of you.

Grass Wonder gave a slight bow and took 
her leave.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer... El is...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Was I... getting ahead of myself?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I could run with so much more 
ease. If El truly aims to be the world's 
strongest, that is..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Far from having breathing room, it was the 
total opposite. I couldn't catch up right 
until the very, very end...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Here I am talking about taking on the 
world, but could it be that I'm 
actually...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Did you just take the easy way out without 
competing against your peers, desu ka?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: If that's the case...

A single match alone reveals nothing. How 
should I interpret today's race?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Si, that's right. This must just be 
fatigue... If I run normally... I'm the 
world's strongest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm wearing this mask, there's 
nothing to be afraid of... I hope!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And so, our next target race is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "Japan Cu...p! Kuu...!"

She can't make the declaration. Hovering 
between her pride and reality, El Condor 
Pasa remains suspended in midair.

Pushing through like this is simply 
impossible. In that case, it might be 
better to add one more step beforehand.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"The Mainichi Okan...? If I recall, that's 
right before the autumn GⅠs..."

An autumn GⅠ trial race. An 1,800m contest 
featuring senior-class competitors as 
well.

From here, we can naturally head to the 
Japan Cup, as well as the Kikuka Sho for 
the Triple Crown, or the Mile 
Championship.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit... like running away, isn't it. 
But...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. For now, there... I want to 
think about lots of things before autumn 
comes, yes...

A mask beginning to slip... The clearly 
visible path to becoming the world's 
strongest wavered for the very first time.
